messages:
lauren: Hey team — planning a relaunch of the dev newsletter plus a new onboarding drip for trial users. Main KPI: activation (created_api_key + first successful call). Need segment-specific subject lines, cadence, A/B plan, and owners. Launch target next Tue 10am PT. Quick thoughts?

ravi: Love it. Propose two core segments: `new_signups` (first 7 days) and `engaged_prospects` (opened >1 marketing mail last 30d). Topic map + cadence per segment. I can export SFDC lists.

miguel: For `new_signups` I recommend a 5-email sequence over 2 weeks: Welcome, Quickstart (code snippet), Best practices, Benchmarks, Invite to webinar. Keep subject lines concise.

chandra: For `engaged_prospects` add a case study + pricing signal email. Also want to run an A/B subject test: Benefit headline vs Question headline. I can own copy. :writing_hand:

zoe: I can build the flows in MailerSend. Need the segments from SFDC and the HTML snippets. @ravi can you drop the exports?

ravi: @zoe yep — I'll drop `new_signups.csv` and `engaged_prospects.csv` to the shared folder by EOD and tag here. Also suggest gating the 'best practices' asset behind a tiny cheat-sheet (email capture -> track downloads).

kyle: Analytics note — activation event = `created_api_key` + `first_successful_call`. I'll set funnel and attribute by UTM + user_id. Will also track per-email conversion.

newsletter-bot: Automated: campaign skeleton `dev-relaunch-2026` created using template `developer-compact`.

lauren: A/B test plan: subjects (benefit vs question vs emoji). Primary metric: activation rate. Secondary: open rate and click-through. Winner moves to 60% traffic after 48h.

miguel: Subject line ideas for `new_signups` — short list: 1) "Welcome — 3-min setup to call the API" 2) "Start generating: your first 5 calls" 3) "Drop inference latency with this config" 4) "Your API key + 2x speed tips"

chandra: I'll run the A/B on 20% of traffic: variant A = "3-min setup"; variant B = "Start generating". If uplift in activation > 10% at 48h, we promote.

zoe: Proposed send cadence for `new_signups`: Day0 (welcome), Day2 (quickstart), Day5 (best practices), Day9 (benchmarks), Day14 (webinar invite) + re-engagement Day21. Sounds reasonable?

lauren: Yes. Owners: Copy — chandra; Flow build — zoe; Lists/segmentation — ravi; Tracking/analytics — kyle; Creative (banner/snippets) — miguel; Legal signoff — ravi to loop legal. I'll create Asana tasks and put final review Mon 9am PT.

ravi: I'll ping legal about the gated cheat-sheet and data handling. Also will include `source=trial` filter on exports.

kyle: Will add UTM params and test events in staging. Example UTM to use: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=dev-relaunch&utm_content=welcome`

miguel: I'll mock up the hero banner + small GIF. Need brand assets from design — @ella can you drop the latest SVG + color tokens?

ella: Dropping assets now in `design/assets/newsletter/relaunch/` and added a short variant guide.

lauren: Great — thanks everyone. Deliverables summary: 1) final subject candidates (chandra/miguel) 2) flow built in MailerSend (zoe) 3) segment exports (ravi) 4) tracking wired (kyle) 5) creative (miguel/ella) 6) legal check (ravi). Final review Mon 9am PT, launch Tue 10am PT.

chandra: One more ask — can we set a tiny incentive in email 3 (best practices) to boost clicks? e.g., a one-page cheat sheet + invite to a 30-min office hours.

lauren: Yep — include office hours CTA and simple download. We'll measure click->signup for office hours as a leading indicator.

zoe: I'll prototype the HTML and share preview links by tomorrow.

newsletter-bot: Reminder scheduled: final-review meeting created Mon 09:00 PT — attendees: lauren, chandra, zoe, ravi, kyle, miguel.

lauren: Perfect. Thanks — I'll update the roadmap and Asana. Ping this thread with any blockers. :rocket:
